heading_path: 4. In whose name may a divisional application be filed?
chunks.text: A divisional application may be filed by the applicant of the parent application or by a person who has become the applicant of the parent application because of an amendment, assignment or transmission. Where an applicant has undergone a change of name this may require further information or documentation to establish that the underlying legal identity is the same. Part 43 Assignment and Transmission
